mapper.sql: select notification_id, user_id, channel, business_key, title, body, route_type, route_params, read_status, read_time, create_time from sys_user_notification
mapper.insert: insert ignore into sys_user_notification ( user_id, channel, business_key, title, body, route_type, route_params, read_status, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{channel}, #{businessKey}, #{title}, #{body}, #{routeType}, #{routeParams}, #{readStatus}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by notification_id desc
select coalesce(max(notification_id), 0) from sys_user_notification where user_id = #{userId}
order by create_time desc, notification_id desc limit #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
select distinct route_type from sys_user_notification where user_id = #{userId} and route_type <> '' order by route_type
mapper.update: update sys_user_notification set read_status = '1', read_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and notification_id <= #{snapshotMaxId} and read_status = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user_notification where user_id = #{userId} and read_status = '0'
